## What it is

A parametric reconstruction of the MaixCAM2 enclosure, top radiator grille, camera assembly, and two separate PMOD socket components.

## Design notes

The source STL is rotated 180 degrees around Y so the enclosure bottom sits on the print bed and the camera faces upward. The lower enclosure is reconstructed as a solid exterior while measured interfaces and the dominant top features remain editable. Each PMOD connector is a separate 2 x 6 female socket with the standard 2.54 mm pitch, twelve square entrances, and a shared definition.

The camera foot has a flat 17.44 mm circular seating surface. The supplied 28 x 19 x 3 mm STEP adapter is preserved as a separate component and placed with its 1 mm underside pocket seated directly over that foot. Its 15 mm central opening clears the coaxial lens, which is also a separate component.

The connector housings intentionally follow the hardware standard rather than the STL's scan-softened bowls. Housing placement and the enclosure pockets follow the scan; pitch and contact layout follow the PMOD interface.

## Don't

Do not move the camera, PMOD fields, grille, or side openings without checking their mating hardware.
